pageInfo.name: Pending Approvals
pageInfo.purpose: Review and approve emission entries submitted by Energy Managers

faqs.question: How do I approve an entry?
faqs.answer: Review the entry details, verify the data is accurate, then click the Approve button. You can also reject entries that need corrections.

faqs.question: When should I reject an entry?
faqs.answer: Reject entries when required fields are missing, units are incorrect, source category is mismatched, or evidence is insufficient. Add clear comments so the submitter can correct and resubmit quickly.

faqs.question: How should I prioritize approvals?
faqs.answer: Prioritize entries with close reporting deadlines, large emission impact, or repeated rejection history to reduce reporting delays and data quality issues.

pageInfo.name: Approved Entries
pageInfo.purpose: View and track approved emission records

faqs.question: Where can I see approved entries?
faqs.answer: Open the Approved Entries page to view records that have completed review and are included in reporting outputs.

faqs.question: Can approved entries be changed?
faqs.answer: Approved records are usually controlled to protect audit trails. If correction is needed, follow your workflow for amendment or resubmission with reviewer approval.

pageInfo.name: Plant Admin Dashboard
pageInfo.purpose: Overview of facility emissions and pending tasks

faqs.question: What is shown on the Plant Admin dashboard?
faqs.answer: It highlights pending approvals, recent submissions, facility-level emission summaries, and task indicators for review actions.

faqs.question: How can I reduce approval backlog?
faqs.answer: Review by deadline and emission impact, reject with specific comments when needed, and coordinate with Energy Managers on common validation issues to improve first-time approval rates.
